references.text: Continuation of the instructions on joining the tent curtains, where five curtains are to be fastened together
The fulfillment of the instruction in Exodus 26:3, where Bezalel and the craftsmen actually joined five tent curtains
Describes the actual joining of the tent curtains into one whole, as the fulfillment of the instruction
Further instructions on how the joined curtains are to be fastened with gold hooks to form a single tabernacle
This verse describes the connecting mechanism (the loops) that allows the two groups of five coverings to become one unit.
This verse reveals the purpose of the sewing: to create unity ('it shall be one') for the tent.
